name: Codegen_Code-Search-CDP_Benchmarking
description: A benchmarking collection for code search and code generation models that evaluates retrieval and ranking quality for CodeGen-style models. It measures how well queries map to relevant code snippets and is intended to compare models on code search effectiveness and downstream code generation utility.
general_score_metric: recall@1 (with recall@5/10 and MRR as additional metrics)
reputation: Used by researchers evaluating CodeGen variants and code-retrieval pipelines but not among the most widely adopted public code-search benchmarks.
